split: route_split seed42; identical bytes grouped; singleton rebalance; same assignments for both combinations
base_thresholds: exact_search on fit rows only; val and devhard each precision >= .995; original exact-search tie ordering
automatic_family: 16 existing inline/safe switch policies; a fixed p2 counterfactual is created only for the fit-selected ungated winner
province_gate: after first original automatic decision, require at least two distinct valid routes in its same candidate and same rect to support its predicted province character; B solo may use any one rect in that same candidate; otherwise reject automatic pass and go to manual fallback without searching further automatic events
automatic_selection: choose the highest-coverage ungated policy among the 16 whose fit val/devhard precision is each >= .995; deterministic ties: baseline 000/safe-000, fewer legacy switches, lexical ID. Then, if any nonempty fit auto subgroup among dark/green/fn/challenge/non-Anhui has precision < .99, evaluate only the paired p2 gate for that winner; adopt p2 only if its fit val/devhard precision each remain >= .995, otherwise retain the ungated winner. The p2 comparison never selects among other switch policies.

evaluation: freeze ungated winner and paired p2 adoption using fit only before scoring either on hold/full; no hold-driven reselection or new rules.
